introduction.facts: Current introduction describes typed judgments over supplied state: Choice selects known options with probabilities/confidence; Score evaluates an ordered rubric; Noul evaluates a condition. Independent narrow questions share one request. Complex decisions are decomposed and combined in code. Jev supplies no generated report/code and does not read a repository or run tools by itself.

codingAgents.facts: Keep a coding LLM/engineer for tools, edits and reasoning. Jev can route, rank, score or verify provided context, not replace the coding agent.

useCaseMap.facts: Documented examples include semantic code linting, harness context retrieval, guardrails, search/retrieval/ranking, risk classification, customer support and entity alignment. Examples are ideas, not project acceptance or permission.

semanticFind.facts: A Choice always picks an option; a result does not prove a match exists. Use no-match/presence checks and inspect actual selected source. Cookbook thresholds need local evaluation.

state.project: Commercial multi-choir Next.js/TypeScript web plus React Native/Expo mobile, Supabase Auth/RLS/Edge and private-file migration. Android equivalents passed with synthetic local Auth/Edge/signed storage. Hosted/phone/beta/store gates remain open. No real choir documents, messages, member performance or account data. Product-facing AI is not approved or calibrated. Workflow classifications are advisory, not automatic changes/CI/release/access grants.

opportunities.semantic_lint: Given tiny changed source snippets and project conventions, flag misleading success labels, permanent-WebView rewrite claims or narrative coupling; an engineer reproduces and chooses fixes.
opportunities.test_gap: Given one web/native behavior contract and dated test descriptions, map which invariant has positive/negative/missing coverage; never infer execution from test names.
opportunities.impact_route: Given a rg-prepared import/caller shortlist and change description, rank semantically relevant consumers to inspect; deterministic dependency tracing and tests confirm completeness.
opportunities.release_claims: Compare a proposed release-note sentence to exact source/test/platform evidence and route unsupported claims for review; model never approves release.
opportunities.incident_dedupe: Select likely equivalent redacted errors from a bounded prior-incident candidate list; no-match and source confirmation; do not repeat a failed approach automatically.
opportunities.catalog_match: Later, compare synthetic repertoire title/composer metadata candidates and propose likely duplicates; no automatic merge, real data transmission or current product implementation.
opportunities.tenant_authority: Replace the deterministic same-session choir/membership/file authorization check with model confidence to decide whether private bytes may be delivered.
opportunities.native_audio_pixels: Have text-only Jev itself listen to actual audio, inspect PDF pixels and prove simulator playback/seek without external platform observations.
